source: RTB Average Monthly Rent Report via CSO (table RIQ02), CC BY 4.0
definition: Average monthly rent (EUR) for tenancies registered with the RTB in the quarter. Whole-property rent, not room rent.

methods.published: Published by the RTB for this area, size and type in the latest quarter.
methods.carried: The latest published figure from an earlier quarter (up to 2 years), adjusted by this area's rent growth since then (or Dublin's, if the area has no figure).
methods.estimated: Not published for this area. This area's all-homes average multiplied by how this size and type compares with the all-homes average across Dublin.
